title: feat(kanban): the board's own view settings, lane header create and menu, and a lane statistic
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"zhuangjianguo"} -->
_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbCxiFE11rsKwyNffJZKYqJs)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jRKaa4gJCNNF5QMd8t

Fixes #36370

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: carried by #36422

Claim: 7076741092

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：看板视图的「视图设置」换成看板自己的一套——分列字段（只列单选/单选按钮字段）、显示哪几列（「5 / 7」，可拖动排序、可隐藏）、卡片上显示的字段（拖动排序、隐藏、「+ 添加字段」）、「显示字段名」「隐藏空字段」两个开关、列底统计（无 / 计数 / 数字字段求和）；表格的「显示的列 / 分组 / 行高 / 行颜色」在看板上不再出现。每列表头加「+」（新建并预填该列的值，空列另有「+ 新建」行）和「⋯」（折叠这一列、隐藏这一列）。
- 规则：除折叠外，所有改动沿用 #35955 的草稿规则——立即生效、出现「放弃 / 保存」、保存前不写任何东西；「保存到这个视图」「另存为我的视图」都带上看板设置。折叠只记在本浏览器，按「用户 : 对象 : 视图」分开（localStorage 键 `objectui:kanban-lanes-collapsed:<用户 id>:<对象>:<视图 id>`）。隐藏一列沿用 #28211 `lanes` 的含义：这一列的卡片移到「未分类」，菜单和「显示哪几列」页都写明这一点。
- 协议：`KanbanConfig` 加三个可选键：`summary`（新的 `KanbanLaneSummary`，只收 `{type:'none'}` / `{type:'count'}` / `{type:'sum', field}`，`sum` 必须写字段；优先于 `summarizeField`）、`showFieldLabels`、`hideEmptyFields`（两者缺省为 true，即现在的卡片），均无 spec 默认值，旧视图不变；L2 看 schema 面。lint 检查 `kanban.summary.field`（字段名、以及求和字段的类型；是 / 否字段不能求和，和设置面板一致）。另修 Console 一直丢掉 `kanban.lanes` 的转发（#28211），并让 Studio 预览（plugin-view）也转发三个新键（即 #36426 要的转发，由座位关闭该卡）。
- 未做：列底求和现在只算已加载的卡片（列未加载完时写明「仅已加载的卡片」），整列求和、平均 / 最小 / 最大要等服务端按列聚合，另立 #36520；查找 / 人员 / 主从 / 树形字段分列另立 #36430（卡片验收里「换成商机负责人」这一条随它走，本 PR 用另一个单选字段「审批状态」验收）；卡片底部图标开关另立 #36423；新增列选项、卡片布局、Studio 设计器、手机看板不在本卡范围。

## What changes

**1. The board's own 视图设置 (`plugin-list`).** `ViewSettingsPopover` takes a `kanban` prop (`ViewSettingsKanban`); `ListView` builds it on a board, and the panel then draws, in place of the table's columns, Group, Row height and Row colour:

| Row | What it writes |
|---|---|
| 分列字段 (lane field) | `groupByField`, from the object's `select` and `radio` fields, and drops `lanes` with it |
| 显示哪几列 `5 / 7` | `lanes`: hide, show (at the end), drag to reorder, 「显示全部」; the last shown lane has no eye; `undefined` when the list is every option in its own order |
| 卡片上显示的字段 | `columns`: drag, hide in place, 「+ 添加字段」 adds at the end |
| 显示字段名 / 隐藏空字段 | `showFieldLabels` / `hideEmptyFields`: `false` when turned off, absent when on |
| 列底统计 | `summary`: none, count, or the sum of a field the aggregate table's `sum` row accepts (a number or currency; no percent, formula or yes / no field); None over a view with `summarizeField` writes `{ type: 'none' }` |

`ListView` gains `onKanbanChange(patch)` (`null` in a patch means the key leaves the block) and `laneCollapseKey`. The phone settings sheet shares `ViewSettingsContent`, so it shows the same board rows. `FieldList` gains `hiddenTitle` and `typeIcons` so the lanes list reads 「隐藏的列」, draws no field-type icon, and carries the line 「隐藏的列里的卡片会显示在「未分类」。」

**Lane fields left out.** A lookup, user, master-detail or tree field draws no sensible lanes yet: the board keys a lane on the stored value, and an expanded reference is an object (measured live: `[object Object]` lanes). A boolean has no options to title its lanes. So the picker offers `select` and `radio` only, and #36430 carries the reference lanes. An authored lookup `groupByField` draws wrong today, independently of this PR.

**Hiding a lane.** `lanes` keeps its #28211 meaning: it picks lanes, not records, so the cards of a hidden lane show under 「未分类」. The 「⋯」 item reads 「隐藏这一列」 with 「这一列的卡片会移到「未分类」」 under it, and the lanes level says the same.

**2. Lane header 「+」 and 「⋯」 (`plugin-kanban`).** `ObjectKanban` takes the host's `laneMenu` request (`KanbanLaneMenuRequest`: `collapseKey`, `onHideLane`, `onCreateInLane`), relayed to `KanbanImpl` over a package-private context (the `KanbanColumnSummary` pattern; never a node key). Without it no header draws either control. 「+」 reports its lane; an empty lane also gets a 「+ 新建」 row. 「⋯」 holds 折叠这一列 / 展开这一列 and 隐藏这一列; the `Uncategorized` lane offers collapse only. Collapse is kept per browser under `objectui:kanban-lanes-collapsed:<collapseKey>`, written only after a user toggle; `ListView` passes `<user id>:<object>:<view>`, the view named by the host's `laneCollapseKey` (the Console passes the view's id), else the schema's `id`, else `-`; a signed-out reader is `-`. A collapsed lane's heading opens it again, and an open lane keeps its bare title. `ListView` wires create as `onEdit({ [laneField]: value })`, the seeded-record create the calendar already uses (objectui#12291), and hide as unticking the lane (at least one lane stays).

**3. The lane statistic and the card toggles (`plugin-kanban`).** `summary` draws at each lane's foot (`[data-kanban-lane-statistic]`, 「计数 2」, 「合计 · 金额 ¥40」) and replaces the `summarizeField` header total; `{ type: 'none' }` draws neither. `laneStatistic(cards, field, type)` counts or sums. `count` is the lane's own count, the server's where the board pages the lane, and a windowed count reads `+`. **`sum` totals the cards the lane has loaded, not every record of the lane**: a windowed lane's sum says so, 「合计 · 金额 · 仅已加载的卡片」 (`data-kanban-lane-statistic-partial`), rather than a `+` on a sum, and the `summary` docblock and `.describe()` say the same. **Why no push-down here:** the board has no lane aggregate read today, and adding one (one grouped `sum` over the view's filter, answering every lane) is the next stage. Per the maintainer's ruling of 13:52Z (「还没开工的不应该开工啊，分多个阶段的只做完当前阶段」) and seat 7's ruling on L2 S3, this PR ships the current stage only and #36520 carries the server lane statistic: the whole-lane sum, then average, minimum and maximum. Those three are not admitted by the schema meanwhile: over the loaded cards of a windowed lane they would be wrong with no honest marker. `showFieldLabels: false` draws card values without their names (`KanbanCardDisplayContext`); `hideEmptyFields: false` keeps an empty field's line with a dash. Without the keys, boards draw as before.

**4. The draft (`app-shell`).** The board's changes are a list-draft part: `ListDraft.kanban` holds only the changed keys (`nextKanbanDraft` drops a key changed back to the view's own as the board draws it, `kanbanViewOptions`, so an auto-detected lane field picked back is no change; `null` = removed). `objectViewListRenderer` lays it over the view's block (`layKanbanDraft`) and wires `onKanbanChange`; `ObjectView` hands it to 「保存到这个视图」 and 「另存为我的视图」 as `display.kanban`, and Discard drops it. On a board whose view declares no `kanban` block (or one without `groupByField`), the lane field is auto-detected, so the draft holds no lane; `kanbanDraftToSave` lays the lane the board draws under the draft, so a saved block carries the `groupByField` `KanbanConfigSchema` requires whenever the board draws one (a view naming no lane on an object with no detectable lifecycle field draws no lanes, and a save there is refused by the server as before) (found in the L2 of 72589856; red without the fix on both save paths, pinned). `ListDraftActions` lists the part as 「看板设置」.

**5. In-surface fixes: both producers relay the board block.** `kanbanViewOptions` (Console) relayed the lane field, title, card fields and `summarizeField` but never `lanes`, so a Console board drew every option whatever the view declared (#28211). It now relays `lanes` (a non-empty array) and the three new keys, each only when declared. `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView#generateViewSchema` (Studio preview, SDUI `object-view`) relays `summary`, `showFieldLabels` and `hideEmptyFields` the same way, so `summary: { type: 'none' }` hides the header total there too. This is the relay #36426 asks for; #36426 holds no claim naming this branch, so the seat closes it.

**6. Lint (`@objectstack/lint`).** `validate-list-view-field-refs` walks `kanban.summary.field` as a field reference (`error`, the `columns[].summary.field` level: a stale name draws nothing, so the statistic the author asked for is gone without a word), and refuses, under `list-view-summary-field-type-refused` at `kanban.summary`, a `sum` over a field the aggregate table's `sum` row refuses **and over a `boolean` or `toggle` field**, which the table admits but the board does not add (the picker leaves them out the same way). `os explain` names the position.

**7. Spec widening (`@objectstack/spec`).** `KanbanConfigSchema` gains `summary: KanbanLaneSummarySchema.optional()`, `showFieldLabels: z.boolean().optional()`, `hideEmptyFields: z.boolean().optional()`, no defaults. `KanbanLaneSummarySchema` is a discriminated union of `none`, `count` and `sum` with a required non-empty `field` (exports `KanbanLaneSummary` and `KanbanLaneSummaryParsed`). Regenerated: `authorable-surface/ui.json`, `api-surface`, `export-origins`, the strictness ledger, `content/docs/references/{ui/view,api/protocol,data/object,index}.mdx`. `variant-docs.json` gains the union's row (`generated-reference-only`; the teaching is #36422). Liveness: the `kanban` row of `liveness/view.json` names each key's read points on both producers.

## Seat rulings this PR follows

Both from seat 7 (`domain:objectstack` seat 7, thread session `session_01QsR2jTeURPvEm465RcoYEC`), in the #36370 card thread at 2026-11-22T11:19Z, answering this PR's two questions:

- **A (lane fields):** 「the lane-field picker offers only option-backed fields (select and radio, plus boolean only if it draws sensibly). Say in the body that lookup, user, master_detail and tree lanes are out, and I will file a card for them: distinct-value lanes, FK bucketing, FK lane queries and FK writes on drag. Also say that an authored lookup groupByField draws wrong today, independent of this PR.」 The card is #36430 (seat 7, 11:24Z). The card's acceptance line 「把分列字段换成『商机负责人』」 names a user field, so it moves to #36430; the live run below switches to the other select field, 审批状态.
- **B (hiding a lane):** 「keep #28211's meaning of lanes in this PR, because changing a published key's meaning is the maintainer's call. In the body, say plainly that hiding a lane moves its cards into 未分类, and use a menu label and help line that tell the truth about it.」

Also followed: seat 7 on L2 S3 (2026-11-22T16:41Z): carrier, no push-down in this PR, current stage only; #36520 filed.

## Left out (stated)

- **The whole-lane sum, and average, minimum, maximum lane statistics**: wait for a server lane read, #36520 (above).
- **Lookup, user, master-detail and tree lane fields**: #36430.
- **Card footer icons toggle**: no per-board data (no per-card comment or attachment count, no stage-entered timestamp). #36423.

## Tests

- `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneMenu-36370.test.tsx` (4): no controls without `laneMenu`; 「+」 and the empty-lane row report their lane, an open lane's heading is no disclosure; 「Hide column」 reports its lane, `Uncategorized` offers collapse only; collapse persists under the host key, reopens from the heading, another key is unaffected.
- `plugin-kanban/src/ObjectKanban.laneStatistic-36370.test.tsx` (7): count, sum (in place of the header total), none (also over `summarizeField`), a partial sum worded as the loaded cards' with its CONTROL, the two toggles and their defaults; `laneStatistic` units.
- `plugin-list/src/__tests__/ViewSettingsPopover.kanban-36370.test.tsx` (6) and `ListView.kanbanSettings-36370.test.tsx` (3): the board rows and none of the table's; the lane field picker offers select and radio only; the statistic offers number and currency sums and no percent, formula or boolean; lanes hide/show/keep-last with the 「Hidden columns」 heading and no type icon; card fields hide/add; toggles and statistic writes; the collapse key per reader, object and view; the zh pack names every row.
- `plugin-view/src/__tests__/ObjectView.harness.test.tsx` (+1): the three keys reach the generated board node when declared, none when not.
- `app-shell/src/views/kanbanDraft-36370.test.ts` (7) and `ObjectView.kanbanSaveAs-36370.test.tsx` (3; the first red without the save-as fix, the other two red without `kanbanDraftToSave`: 「另存为我的视图」 and 「保存到这个视图」 on a board with no `kanban` block store `groupByField`): the draft keeps changed keys only; lay with `null`; Save lays the draft into a body `ListViewSchema` accepts; 「另存为我的视图」 on a package board writes nothing before Save and stores the board's changes; the `kanbanViewOptions` relay and its omissions.
- `packages/spec/src/ui/kanban-config-lane-summary.test.ts` (4) and `packages/lint` (+5 cases): the schema takes none, count and a field's sum and refuses avg/min/max, a fieldless sum and a stray key; lint's stale-field row, the sum-type verdict, and a sum over a `boolean` and a `toggle` refused at `kanban.summary`.
- After the L2 of 72589856 (this head): `@objectstack/lint` `validate-list-view-field-refs.test.ts` 199 / 199; the 32 app-shell files naming kanban, the draft, personal views, save-as, shared-view save, the footer calculation draft, the stored row or view options, 269 / 269; `@objectstack/spec` `src/ui` 185 / 6568; `check:generated` all 14 up to date; eslint on the moved files 0 errors.
- Suites on the earlier head: `plugin-kanban` 83 files / 546 tests, `plugin-list` 186 / 2027, `plugin-view` 66 / 730, `@object-ui/i18n` 106 / 1978, `@objectstack/lint` 225 / 9431, `@objectstack/spec` 964 / 29475, and the app-shell test files naming kanban, the list draft, personal views or the relay; type-check of `plugin-kanban`, `plugin-list`, `plugin-view`, `i18n`, `app-shell` and `lint` exit 0. `dispatch-gates --ran`: 121 derived, 121 run, 0 NOT MEASURED. `overlap-check`: merges cleanly with main; #36435, #36437 and #36316 meet it only on generated counts and the de quote-pair pin, which the second to land regenerates.

## Verification (live)

Local backend (`objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh`) and the Console in zh (CNY), signed in as the seeded administrator, at the code of 16a019dc05. Two boards: the CRM example's pipeline (a view the read-only CRM package ships) and a **self-built app** made through the administrator's own doors (`POST /api/v1/packages` for package `com.qa.board36370`, then `PUT /api/v1/meta/object/qab_task`, `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/qab_task.board` and `PUT /api/v1/meta/app/qab_app` into it, five records by `POST /api/v1/data/qab_task`; lane field 阶段 = 待办 / 进行中 / 评审 / 完成, card fields 名称 / 工时 / 备注, 备注 empty on three cards).

**Screenshots are not inline.** GitHub has no API that uploads an image into a PR body (the `user-attachments` upload is the browser's only), and AGENTS.md's 「Delete temporary artifacts — screenshots…」 rule keeps them out of the branch. They are in the project folder `issue-36370/` under the names given below; the seat weighs this against the card's 「PR 正文附视图设置和列菜单的截图」.

Writes are read off the browser's network log. The only writes not listed are the reader's recent-items rows (`sys_user_preference`, written when a page opens, before any change).

CRM pipeline (first run):

- 视图设置 shows 分列字段 阶段, 显示哪几列 5 / 5, the card fields, both toggles and 列底统计; no 显示的列, 分组, 行高 or 行颜色. The lane field picker offers 阶段 and 审批状态 (both select). The statistic offers 无, 计数, 合计 · 金额 and 合计 · 产品合计. (`settings.png`, `settings-lane-field.png`, `settings-summary.png`)
- On the package view: hiding 输单, turning 显示字段名 off and picking 计数 apply at once (4 lanes plus 未分类, no `dt`, 计数 1 / 2 / 1 / 7 / 1) with **no write**; 放弃 restores every lane, label and the header total with no write. Save offers 另存为我的视图 alone. (`settings-lanes.png`, `board-sum-nolabels.png`)
- 另存为我的视图: one `POST sys_personal_view`; the new view opens with the changes and keeps them after a reload. **This run found the path dropped the board part**; fixed in `ObjectView#handleSaveAsMyView` and pinned. (`board-saved-reload.png`)
- On that own view: 合计 · 金额 at each foot; 保存到这个视图 writes one `PATCH sys_personal_view`, kept after a reload. (`save-menu-own.png`)
- 「⋯」 on 需求确认 offers 折叠这一列 and 隐藏这一列 with its 未分类 line; collapse is stored under `objectui:kanban-lanes-collapsed:<user id>:crm_opportunity:<view id>` and holds after a reload. (`lane-menu.png`, `board-collapsed.png`)
- 「+」 on 方案报价 opens 新建商机 with 阶段 = 方案报价. (`lane-create.png`)
- **This run also found the statistic offering a sum of the two percent fields**; the picker now asks the aggregate table's `sum` row, as lint does.

CRM pipeline (supplement for the acceptance lines the first run did not walk):

- **Lane field swap, then 放弃.** 分列字段 → 审批状态: the board re-lanes at once to 待审批 / 已批准 / 已驳回 / 已撤回 / 未分类 (all 12 opportunities in 未分类, none has an approval status), 放弃 / 保存 appear, **no write**. 放弃: back to 初步接洽 / 需求确认 / 方案报价 / 赢单 / 输单, the bar gone, no write. (`sup-lane-field-picker.png`, `sup-relane-approval.png`) The card's line names 商机负责人, a user field, which ruling A moves to #36430.
- **Drag a lane to the front.** In 显示哪几列, dragging 方案报价 onto the first row (a mouse drag) orders the list 方案报价 / 初步接洽 / 需求确认 / 赢单 / 输单 and the board follows in that order, with 放弃 / 保存 and no write. (`sup-lanes-order.png`, `sup-board-reordered.png`) The pipeline has no 谈判 stage, so the lane is 方案报价.
- **隐藏空字段.** With 审批状态 added as a card field (empty on every card): 隐藏空字段 on, 36 field rows and no dash; turned off, 48 rows, the 12 new ones each 「—」; no write. (`sup-hide-empty-on.png`, `sup-hide-empty-off.png`)
- **Another browser.** With 需求确认 collapsed in one browser, a second browser context signed in as the same reader (its own local storage) draws 需求确认 open with its two cards and holds no collapse key. (`sup-other-browser.png`)

Self-built app (`com.qa.board36370`), administrator:

- The board draws 待办 / 进行中 / 评审 / 完成 with 7 field rows (empty 备注 takes none). 视图设置 shows the same board rows; the statistic offers 无 / 计数 / 合计 · 工时. (`self-board.png`, `self-settings.png`)
- 合计 · 工时 picked and 隐藏空字段 turned off: 10 rows, three 「—」, feet 合计 · 工时 8 / 8 / 2 / 1. 隐藏空字段 back on and 评审 dragged to the front: 7 rows, lanes 评审 / 待办 / 进行中 / 完成, feet follow. No write. (`self-empty-off.png`, `self-changed.png`)
- **保存到这个视图 as an administrator**: Save offers 保存到这个视图 and 另存为我的视图; the confirmation reads 「保存到这个视图？所有用「任务看板」的人都会看到这些改动。」; confirming writes `PUT /api/v1/meta/view/qab_task.board?mode=draft` with `kanban: { groupByField: 'phase', columns: [...], summary: { type: 'sum', field: 'hours' }, lanes: ['review','todo','doing','done'] }` (no `hideEmptyFields`: it was turned back to the view's own) and `POST …/publish`. After a reload the board draws 评审 first with the 合计 · 工时 feet and no draft bar. (`self-save-menu.png`, `self-save-confirm.png`, `self-after-reload.png`)

NOT MEASURED live: the partial-sum wording (no lane here holds more than it loaded; pinned in the unit test), and the Studio preview relay (pinned in plugin-view). The board with no `kanban` block was measured in tests only (both save paths), not live.
